name: teremu
description: Teremu monorepo — shared schemas, Vue app, Cloud Functions API

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace teremu-app && npm run build --workspace teremu-functions
scripts.build:functions: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace teremu-functions
scripts.clean:install: npm run clean && npm install && npm run build:shared
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @teremu/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace teremu-functions && npm run typecheck --workspace teremu-app
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm --prefix firebase run test
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace teremu-app
scripts.functions:watch: npm run build:shared && npm --prefix firebase/functions run build:watch
scripts.emulators: npm run build:shared && npm --prefix firebase run emulators
scripts.emulators:watch: npm run build:shared && npm --prefix firebase run emulators:watch
scripts.emulators:all: npm run build:shared && npm --prefix firebase run emulators:all
